        <gnm:Selection startCol="0" startRow="0" endCol="0" endRow="0"/>

        <gnm:Cell Row="0" Col="1" ValueType="60">value</gnm:Cell>

        <gnm:Cell Row="1" Col="1" ValueType="40">1.25</gnm:Cell>
